check.sealCheckedHelp: Foam / induction seal laga hai, dhakkan poora tight hai.
check.shrinkAppliedHelp: PVC band dhakkan aur gardan par garam karke chipkaya.
check.bubbleWrappedHelp: 2–3 layer; box hilayein — jar bilkul nahi hilna chahiye.
check.labelAppliedHelp: Box par shipping label, FRAGILE aur THIS SIDE UP sticker lagaya.

issue.notReady: {code}: Abhi pack nahi ho sakta — label abhi baaki hai.
issue.notFound: {code}: Ye order aapke kitchen ki list mein nahi hai.
issue.other: {code}: Pack mark nahi ho paya. Dobara koshish karein.

batches.title: Batch
batches.noProducts: Abhi koi product nahi — pehle admin product jodenge.
batches.noShelfLife: Shelf life set nahi — admin se kahein
batches.costHelp: Meat, tel, masale, jar — is batch par jo bhi kharch hua.
batches.madeOnHelp: Aaj bana hai toh aaj hi rehne dein.
batches.notesPlaceholder: jaise Is lot mein lehsun zyada

batches.errForbidden: Aap sirf apne kitchen ka batch likh sakte hain.

batches.errGeneric: Batch save nahi ho paya. Dobara koshish karein.
batches.successCodeLabel: Har jar par ye batch code stamp karein
batches.stockEmptyBody: Banane ke baad naya batch likhein — stock aur expiry ke saath yahan dikhega.

settings.title: Settings
settings.alertsEnable: 🔔 Naye order ka alert chalu karein
settings.alertsOn: Is phone par alert chalu hain.
settings.alertsOff: Naya order aate hi phone par notification aayega.
settings.alertsWhatsapp: Server par phone alert abhi set nahi hain — naye order WhatsApp par aayenge.
settings.alertsUnsupported: Is browser mein alert nahi chalte — naye order WhatsApp par aayenge.
settings.alertsIos: iPhone par alert tabhi chalte hain jab app Home Screen par add ho (neeche steps dekhein).
settings.alertsDenied: Notifications block hain. Browser ki site settings mein allow karke wapas aayein.
settings.alertsNoWorker: Alert live site se app kholne par chalu honge (test build mein nahi).
settings.alertsFailed: Alert chalu nahi ho paye. Dobara koshish karein.
settings.installReady: Packing Desk ko home screen par jodein — app ki tarah khulega.
settings.iosStep4: Home Screen se Pahadi Khatki kholein aur yahan alert chalu karein.
settings.androidStep2: ⋮ menu dabayein → “Install app” ya “Add to Home screen”.
settings.signOutOffline: Sign out ke liye internet chahiye.
